Image of a part.comment: Document type name (CFBundleTypeName) shown in the iOS Open in / Share sheets for a photo or image of a part.

NSAppleMusicUsageDescription.comment: Permission prompt (Apple Music). Keep the exact meaning: the app only plays recordings from the start of an excerpt when the player has a subscription.
NSAppleMusicUsageDescription.english: Auditioner plays Apple Music recordings from the start of an excerpt when you have a subscription.

NSCameraUsageDescription.comment: Permission prompt (camera). Shown the first time the player scans a part.
NSCameraUsageDescription.english: Auditioner uses the camera to scan your part so it can recognise the excerpt and make reference audio.

NSMicrophoneUsageDescription.comment: Permission prompt (microphone). Shown the first time the player records a take.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription.english: Auditioner records your practice so you can compare it with the reference.

PDF part.comment: Document type name (CFBundleTypeName) shown in the iOS Open in / Share sheets for a PDF part.
